newsitem.title: USA: Reuters 10-yr muni GO bond index at 5.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 10-yr muni GO bond index at 5.25 pct.

text.p: Reuters said Thursday its 10-year tax-exempt general obligation bond index was 5.25 percent, up one basis point from last Thursday.
The yield on the index is at its highest level since its inception in August 1996.
Calculated each Thursday, the index MUNINDEX04 represents the non-weighted average yield on 15 state and local municipal bonds of 10-year maturity and ratings ranging from A-minus to AAA.

The issues are from Maryland; North Carolina; Texas Permanent School Fund; Columbus, Ohio; Fairfax County, Va.; Connecticut; Florida Board of Education; Wisconsin; Atlanta, Georgia; Shelby County, Tenn.; California; New York State; Pennsylvania; Dade County, Fla. and Tucson, Ariz.
